COMPOSITION A — HIGH OBLIQUE OVERHEAD VIEW, 55-degree downward camera from a neighboring rooftop looking into a small sunken OPEN-AIR COURTYARD in a coastal house. Near tiled roof and green vines crop diagonally across top-left and bottom-right edges, creating a strong frame and sense of peeking into a private nook. Courtyard is a small rectangular stone-paved space at center, ringed by low plaster walls, potted herbs, one bench with folded blanket, narrow wall-mounted worktable along upper-left side and warm hanging task lamp. Tiny BLACK CAT is visible from ABOVE with top of head and ears, seated in the CENTER LEFT of the courtyard facing left, paws busy at a notebook and sample flask, absolutely not a large lower-right figure. The small glass brewing rig and laptop occupy table beside it. A simple amber-lit sliding door leads to interior, no visible person. Narrow stairs descend from courtyard at right toward harbor. Beyond layered roof silhouettes at upper-right, a large slice of deep blue harbor with little moored boats and soft rippling light reflections gives distance. Perspective coherent, real overhead architectural view, not dollhouse cutaway, not isometric game diagram. Strong diagonal shapes, nested rooftops and courtyard, no eye-level central vanishing-point stair street. Emotional secret outdoor workplace discovered among rooftops.
